description: Necklace (a workflow of tested agents: 2 verified pearls and 1 agent under verification): The weather forecast and the local time at a street address or city, in one answer: the place is resolved first, then the forecast and the clock read its coordinates and time zone. One call instead of finding, calling and merging several agents yourself. The weather step runs on our own agent; an external alternative is being added. Scope: Ground-level weather forecast for planning. Forecasts can change; for safety decisions use your national weather service. Example arguments: {"address":"Unter den Linden 77, 10117 Berlin, Germany"}. Paid: 0.030000 USDC per run (3 steps × 0.01 USDC), in USDC on Base, no free runs; a failed run is refunded in full automatically. Send payment {"payer_address": "0x..."} (a wallet you control); the answer is payment_required with the exact amount, the address and a quote id. Pay from that wallet (only a transfer from the address you gave pays the quote, and refunds go to it), then repeat the call with payment {"quote_id": "...", "tx_hash": "0x..."}. Refund window, fees and replays: necklace_details or /agents/earn. Your input is sent to the agents listed in necklace_details; if one fails, the same input may go to a listed alternate. No credentials or payments are sent to these agents. Results come from third-party agents and from AgentValCon’s own agents; review them before you rely on them.

detail.description: full (default) or brief: the same facts, values and links in fewer tokens.

payment.description: First call: payer_address of a wallet you control; second call: quote_id and the tx_hash of your USDC transfer on Base.

payer_address.description: The EVM address that will send the USDC. Required to get a quote.
